facts.fact: The document says Popia was signed into law in 2013 and that the department stopped publishing learners' surnames in 2014 after Popia was established; it does not state a commencement date.

After a November 2023 POPIA assessment the Information Regulator issued the basic education department a notice not to publish the 2024 matric results in newspapers; the department kept publishing exam numbers.
